snippet.title: Void Tech - Game Dev Vlog #1
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first episode of our Void Tech game development vlog! In this series, we'll take you behind the scenes of our indie sci-fi adventure game, sharing insights into our development process, challenges, and milestones.

Stay connected:

Wishlist our game Void Tech: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585900/Void_Tech/
Talk with us on our official discord channel: https://discord.gg/jFGSCvGjsV

Check out our released game, Cosmic Resistance: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541580/Cosmic_Resistance/


Website: https://www.wecureboredom.com/

Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe to follow our development journey.   
#indiegame #gaming #gamerlife #gamedevelopment #indiegamesdev
